versions.changelog: Replaces direct-contact MCP quote submission with a read-only saved-plan handoff; buyers review and submit their own contact details on TempGuru form.

TempGuru Pro: Operations inquiry skill improved for clarity and precise lead routing.

- Refined to serve only staffing companies/software operator inquiries, not buyers or agency applicants.
- Added strict rules: do not describe features, pricing, or timelines—only route to TempGuru via email/phone.
- Workflow clearly outlined: confirm operator inquiry, capture a short problem description, and provide a routing template.
- Included explicit hand-off guidance to direct non-operator cases to the appropriate skills or forms.
- Ensured contact info and process for TempGuru operations leads are prominently provided.
